input: Convert old VHS home movies to digital files

gold.taskTitle: Convert Old VHS Home Movies to Digital Files
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to digitize their VHS home movies and save them as digital video files.

questions.title: How many VHS tapes do you need to convert?
questions.description: Understanding the volume of tapes helps estimate time, cost, and effort required.

questions.title: What digital file format do you want as output?
questions.description: Knowing the desired format (MP4, MOV, AVI, etc.) determines the tools and settings needed.

questions.title: Do you want to do this yourself or hire a service?
questions.description: This determines whether the plan focuses on DIY equipment and software or finding a professional conversion service.

questions.title: Do you still have a working VHS player available?
questions.description: Access to a functioning VHS player is a critical dependency for any DIY approach.

questions.title: Where do you plan to store the final digital files?
questions.description: The storage destination (external hard drive, cloud, NAS, etc.) affects file size and format decisions.

questions.title: Do you want the footage edited or left as raw captures?
questions.description: Knowing whether editing, trimming, or chapter-marking is desired affects the scope of the project significantly.

questions.title: Is there a deadline or specific event driving this project?
questions.description: A deadline such as a family reunion or anniversary shapes how urgently and in what order tasks should be prioritized.
